_note: Hand-measured on a 43-frame temporal median of the 240 s clip (players removed), each point the intersection of two painted red volleyball lines read off 7x zoom crops with a pixel grid. Elevated fixed camera at one end of the net line (court long axis runs left-right, the net projects to a near-vertical line at x~1040-1090). Naming: near end = LEFT end line, far end = RIGHT end line; l sideline = the far/top sideline (y~485), r sideline = the near/bottom sideline (y~703) - a rotation, not a mirror, of the template (+x toward r, +y toward the far end). net_post_l / net_post_r are where the painted centre line under the net (the blue half-court line, which lies under the net: it agrees with the post-base line to ~2 px) crosses each sideline.
